collapse: The final whistle blows — and {name} drops. The physio races on, the crowd gasps… and then the grass starts to fizz.

choices.label: Splash water on his face
choices.hint: Though something is definitely floating in that bottle.
choices.reveal: {name} coughs, sits bolt upright, and is suddenly moving faster than the eye can follow. FWOOSH!

choices.label: Get him onto the stretcher
choices.hint: Is that a beetle the size of a plum sitting on the canvas?
choices.reveal: The bug takes one tiny bite — and {name} leaps up wreathed in flame. The referee reaches for the extinguisher.

choices.label: Let the pitch-side doctor handle it
choices.hint: The doctor is already uncapping a very unlabelled bottle of pills.
choices.reveal: One gulp, and {name}'s shirt tears clean off the shoulders. He is, quite suddenly, enormous.
